# Git Workflow

Start from a tracked Issue. Use `feature/<issue>-<slug>`, `fix/<issue>-<slug>`, or `refactor/<issue>-<slug>`. Keep commits reviewable and never rewrite shared history without explicit approval.

Pull requests must identify the Issue, locked Skill version, affected data/interfaces, tests, security impact, deploy and rollback steps. Project code and organizational Skill learning are separate PRs.

If GitHub is unavailable, preserve local commits and report that sync, PR and protected release checks are incomplete.
